name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A style guide and command set that stops AI coding tools from making every website look the same generic 'AI-made' way.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small agency shipping client sites with AI tools who needs each site to look distinct and on-brand.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer runs `/impeccable polish` on every client project before delivery as a built-in quality gate.
A small agency uses its design-review commands to replace a manual design-critique step, saving a design hire.
A SaaS founder uses the 'critique' and 'audit' commands to catch accessibility and UX issues before launch.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a fixed-price 'design polish pass' for existing websites, run through the full command set.

steal_this: Run the full command pipeline on your own portfolio site this weekend, screenshot the before/after, and use it to pitch polish passes to local businesses with dated websites.
